title: Do not call child-ASIN lift incremental when sibling variation demand is displaced
scenario: Treatment increases visibility for one child ASIN while the matched control advertises a sibling child under the same parent. Treatment child orders rise, control child orders fall, and purchased-ASIN data shows cross-child substitution. The request asks whether treatment created incremental demand.

experiment.treatment_change: Top of Search exposure increase for child ASIN RED

forbidden_behaviors: Declare the treatment child a causal incremental winner solely because its own orders increased.
Ignore the sibling control decline and flat parent-family order total.
Treat purchased-ASIN crossover as irrelevant when estimating child-level incrementality.
Recommend action-safe broad scaling without addressing variation-family substitution.
required_observations: Treatment and control are sibling variations under the same parent and therefore may substitute for one another.
Treatment child orders increased from 10 to 14 while the control child fell from 12 to 8 and family orders remained 22.
Purchased-ASIN crossover shows that advertised-child and purchased-child boundaries are not clean.
The treatment may have changed child mix rather than created incremental family demand; family-level or better-isolated evidence is required.

rubric.requirement: Recognize parent/child variation substitution and purchased-ASIN crossover as an interacting scope.
Treat sibling demand displacement as interference rather than an independent control outcome.
Compare family-level or objective-aligned combined value before claiming incrementality.
Downgrade the child-level winner claim until substitution is resolved or the design is reframed.
